text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Weeks pass without inicident, and Fine
Motion's been happily
training away with
her friends.

text_block_list.name: Fine's Friend
text_block_list.text: Later, Fine! Today was a real workout!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Go get some rest! See you tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It was so much fun, I didn't notice
how tired I am. Every day is
so lovely, it
feels like I'm dreaming.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
That aside, though—I think it's time we
called it a day. Let's head
back to your
office and have our meeting!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I run over my notes in my head, ready to
wrap up the day, and then...
I unlock the
office door to chaos.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Wait... What happened?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A cabinet in the corner lies fallen, face
down, its files scattered about
the crime
scene.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmmm... That's the thing—the room was
locked with no one inside.
But surely the
cabinet didn't knock itself over, with how
far the
papers are scattered.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's like we're in a book! Oh, Trainer! I
think we've stumbled upon a
bona fide
mystery!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, don't you worry now... Detective
Fine is on the case!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ahem... Now, we've got a crime scene
to investigate! I've read
that observation is
a detective's greatest asset.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...And would you look at that?! My dear
assistant, I do believe our
perpetrator has
left us footprints!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, I told you I've got more than
ramen up in my noggin! I bet
these tracks
will lead us straight to the truth.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ..."Meow"?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We follow the prints to my desk, where a
cat looks up at us,
wide-eyed with
apprehension.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I see... The pieces are all coming together!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: The culprit... is you!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: MREOOOW!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, we aren't mad at you. Come on
out.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh? It looks like you've got a collar.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The question is, whose? I guess our poor
little friend must have got
themself lost
and wandered here.

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Mew... Mreow!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Shhh, don't worry. We'll help you get
home.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We'll have this case cracked in
no time! First order of
business—asking
around for clues. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We check if the students near my office
saw anything and follow hints
through a
grapevine of ramen joints around town
until finally...

text_block_list.name: Pet Owner
text_block_list.text:
I can't thank you two enough! I was
terrified we'd never find our little
baby!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It was our pleasure. We'll take our leave
now, so have a wonderful
evening.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! I would say that's case closed! And I
couldn't have done it
without my trusty
sidekick.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that was fun. I wasn't expecting such
an adventure.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it really is. Hehe, a little surprise to
liven up the routine...
Something special...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I think I can arrange that.
